maddeler.e:
ابرغششت (form IVq)
# اِبْرَغْشَشْتُ (ibraḡšaštu) /ib.raɣ.ʃaʃ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
# اِبْرَغْشَشْتَ (ibraḡšašta) /ib.raɣ.ʃaʃ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
# اِبْرَغْشَشْتِ (ibraḡšašti) /ib.raɣ.ʃaʃ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
